summary: bioAffinity Technologies filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 solely to announce the release of a corporate newsletter. The newsletter provides an overview of recent developments but does not disclose any M&A, activist, restructuring, or capital‐return event. No deal terms, stake percentages, or pricing details are included. The filing is a routine current report updating shareholders on business progress. As it lacks any trigger for a special-situations classification, it is categorized as none.
